name: nadeshiko-root
//lint,typecheck,test: `--workspaces --if-present` rather than a hand-written list, so a new workspace is covered the day it is added and a contributor running `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test` cannot pass locally and fail in CI. npm runs them in the order the `workspaces` array declares. Biome runs once over the whole repository from the root `biome.jsonc`; a workspace `lint` holds only what Biome does not cover: backend's `redocly lint` and frontend's locale parity check.
//sdk:sync: Bundles the spec before regenerating the SDK from it, so starting the stack right after a spec edit does not build the SDK from the previous bundle. Runs once per `npm run dev`, not per Nuxt restart, and deliberately stops short of backend `generate:api` -- `dev:backend` does that for itself.

scripts.dev:ports: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run sdk:codegen && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.sdk:sync: npm run docs:bundle --workspace backend && npm run generate:auth-spec --workspace backend && npm run sdk:codegen
scripts.release:set-version: bash -c 'node --import tsx scripts/releaseVersion.ts set "$1" && npm run generate:all --workspace backend && npm run sdk:codegen && node --import tsx scripts/releaseVersion.ts check "$1"' --
scripts.setup: sh scripts/setup-hooks.sh && npm run setup --workspace backend && npm run setup --workspace frontend
